About us

A place for you this Sunday.

We are a church centred on the Scriptures and on the cross. We gather to worship, to learn and to serve — and the door is open to anyone who would rather just watch first.

What to expect

What we believe

The Five Solas

Five statements that sum up the Reformed faith — and hold up everything we do here.

01

Sola Scriptura

Scripture is the final authority in faith and practice — not tradition, not opinion.

02

Sola Fide

We are justified by faith, not by works — faith is the gift that receives the promise.

03

Sola Gratia

Salvation is grace from beginning to end; nothing in it starts with us.

04

Solus Christus

Christ is the only mediator between God and man — there is no other way.

05

Soli Deo Gloria

All glory belongs to God, in the church, in the family and in the workplace.
